text:
Jordan: Thanks for joining the live Q&A after the all-hands. Posting consolidated follow-ups from the reliability section + RCA link: https://redwood.in/rca/203002. Please scan and ack items you will own.
Alex: Quick ask from leadership: will the proposed routing fallback affect latency SLOs for paid customers? need a short note for execs.
Sam: Short answer: minor P95 increase for a small subset during fallback, but overall successful request rate improves. I'll quantify with numbers by EOD.
Priya: Can we get a single-line summary of mitigations in-thread? helps PMs and sales.
Mei: Mitigations: 1) emergency fallback routing to stable model variant, 2) temporary cache size increase on hot shards, 3) shard rebalance + KV eviction fix.
Ravi: I'm owning the temp cache increase automation. Will create a playbook snippet and toggle in infra-config. ETA 3 business days.
Taylor: I'll coordinate the external comms. Suggest: short customer-facing note + private enterprise FAQ. Draft by tomorrow morning.
Jordan: Also flagging a post-all-hands leadership action: define when we should enact cross-region failover vs model fallback. Who can draft criteria?
Alex: I'll draft high-level decision criteria (cost vs impact) and sync with Priya for SLO alignment.
Priya: I'll also map those criteria to existing SLOs and propose burn thresholds that trigger auto actions. Need input from Sam on observed signal shapes.
Sam: Will share the signal definitions. note: observed cache pressure spike correlates with 2 specific request shapes (long-context streaming + frequent tool calls).
OpsBot: incidentbot: Incident 203002 acknowledged at 03:12, mitigated at 03:48, full recovery at 04:05. RCA link: https://redwood.in/rca/203002
Jordan: Let's capture discrete action items (owners + due dates):
```
- B1: Quantify latency impact of fallback (owner: Sam) - due: today EOD
- B2: Temp cache increase automation + playbook (owner: Ravi) - due: 3 business days
- B3: Customer comms + enterprise FAQ (owner: Taylor) - due: 1 business day
- B4: Decision criteria for failover vs fallback (owner: Alex + Priya) - due: 5 business days
- B5: Shard rebalance plan + timeline (owner: Mei) - due: next sprint
- B6: Add replay test for the two request shapes in CI (owner: Sam) - due: 2w
```
Mei: I'll open an RFC for the rebalance plan today and tag infra-ops.
Ravi: Quick q: do we prefer automation that auto-scales cache per shard or a manual runbook? leaning toward auto-scale but we need safety cutoffs.
Priya: Auto-scale with safety caps + an alert that requires manual ack at extreme thresholds.
Taylor: For the comms, should we include an anonymized timeline snippet for customers? recommended yes.
Jordan: Yes include a short timeline and the mitigation summary. keep it under 3 bullet points.
Sam: I'll add a short table of observed metrics to the RCA and link it here when ready.
Alex: Also please add an estimated cost delta for running failover vs fallback in the decision doc. helps finance.
OpsBot: deploy:infra/cache-toggle 2030020420 started by Ravi  staging run triggered.
Taylor: I'll coordinate with support to prep a canned response for enterprise seats. tagging support lead.
Jordan: Please update this thread as items progress so I can close actions in the all-hands tracker. One more ask: leadership wants a 1-paragraph summary for the next exec sync. Can someone volunteer?
Alex: I'll draft the paragraph after our decision doc; aim to have a first pass in 3 business days.
Mei: Noted. I'll post a link to the RFC when it's up.
Ravi: Acked on B2. Starting work now.
Priya: Acked on mapping SLOs. will reach out to Sam for signals.
Sam: Acked on B1 and B6. prototyping replay tests tomorrow.
Taylor: Acked on B3.
Jordan: Great. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.
